query: What formal criteria and pre-registered decision rules will govern adding respondent-level AR(1) or other serial-correlation structures to the main model?

response.query: What formal criteria and pre-registered decision rules will govern adding respondent-level AR(1) or other serial-correlation structures to the main model?
response.answer: Formal criteria include checking residuals for autocorrelation; pre-registered rules involve adding AR(1) if p-value < 0.05. Use Durbin-Watson test for initial assessment.
